label: Generate Video
description: Make a video, sound included, from a prompt, using the video models ElevenLabs serves (Google Veo 3.1, ByteDance Seedance). You can also give it an image to open on, and another to end on. For a video built from reference images, clips or sounds, use Video From References. If you set something the model does not take, the call is refused before anything is charged. Needs your own ElevenLabs account on a Pro plan or above.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account: wire an ElevenLabsAccess node whose connection has "Images and video" ticked. weft's built-in connection cannot make images or videos, and each one is paid from this account's credits.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: What happens in the video: the scene, the action, the camera, and any speech or sound.
inputs.placeholder: A corgi surfs a small wave at sunset, the camera following from the side

inputs.name: startFrame
inputs.description: The image the video opens on.

inputs.name: endFrame
inputs.description: The image the video ends on. Needs `startFrame`.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: veo-3.1-fast-generate-001 (Veo 3.1 Fast) is the quick one, for previews and iteration; veo-3.1-generate-001 is the high-quality one. Seedance 2.5 makes the longest videos, up to 30 seconds; the fast and mini Seedance 2.0 models stop at 720p. The Seedance (ByteDance) models are refused with `model_access_denied` until ElevenLabs approves your workspace (ask ElevenLabs support for access), and are not offered in the United States.

inputs.name: durationSecs
inputs.label: Duration (seconds)
inputs.description: Leave empty for 8 seconds on Veo, 5 on Seedance. Veo takes 4, 6 or 8; Seedance 2.0 takes 4 to 15, Seedance 2.5 4 to 30.

inputs.name: aspectRatio
inputs.label: Aspect ratio
inputs.description: Leave empty for 16:9. Veo takes only 16:9 and 9:16. `auto` (Seedance only) lets the model match your frames, and Seedance 2.5 always uses `auto` when you give it a frame.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.description: Leave empty for 720p. Veo takes 720p, 1080p and 4K; Seedance 2.0 takes 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K, but its fast and mini models only 480p and 720p; Seedance 2.5 takes 480p, 720p and 1080p. 4K and 4k both work.

inputs.name: generateAudio
inputs.label: Sound
inputs.description: The model makes a soundtrack along with the picture. If you want a silent video, untick it.

inputs.name: negativePrompt
inputs.label: Negative prompt
inputs.description: Veo only: what the video should avoid.

inputs.name: promptAsWritten
inputs.label: Use prompt as written
inputs.description: Veo only. Veo may rewrite your prompt to improve it; if you want it used exactly as you wrote it, tick this.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Veo and Seedance 2.0 only. If you want to be able to make a similar video again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same inputs. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

outputs.name: video
outputs.description: The generated video, stored with the run and deleted with it (once the run's record goes); wire it through KeepFile to keep it past that.

then.message: ElevenLabsGenerateVideo '{id}' has an `endFrame` but no `startFrame`: ElevenLabs takes an end frame only together with a start frame, so wire the image the video opens on into `startFrame`.
